deep.reconstruction:
This folio carries no mathematical derivation by Gauss. It is the printed first page of the preface ('Vorbericht') of the textbook bound into the bundle 'HB.Leiste'. That book is Christian Leiste's 'Die Arithmetik und Algebra zum Gebrauch bey dem Unterricht' (Wolfenbüttel, 1790), the school text Gauss used at the Collegium Carolinum in Braunschweig.

The printed text is Leiste's own justification for writing a short textbook:
- Many of his pupils could not afford textbooks.
- He kept being drawn into digressions too long or too hard for beginners.
- He found that most of his own 'discoveries' had already been treated, more fully, by others.
- Leaving material out therefore remained an act of 'self-denial' (Verleugnung).
- The text runs on to page IV (the next page) with remarks on method: building arithmetic on the concept of ratio, and teaching letter-algebra from the start.

The only handwritten matter visible is at the extreme left edge: the right-hand ends of number columns on the facing (previous) page, which show through or protrude into the scan. These match the endings of digit strings in the previous page's transcription:
- ...7726, ...1530 (from 7895668[?]1530)
- ...5284, ...16924, ...71589, ...88513
- ...862862, ...5751375, ...95399
- 1033614740034, 861345616695, 717788013..., 182457, ...7234608, 1028081791, 825316399
- a fraction fragment '1/4 + 5/16'

Those computations belong to the previous page. That page computes the constant 0.83462684167... = 1/agm(1, √2), i.e. ϖ/π (Gauss's constant), via the series Π = (π√2/4)(1 + (1/2)²·(1/2) + (3/8)²·(1/4) + ...). Nothing new is derived on this page.

results.what: Printed preface of Leiste's 1790 textbook on arithmetic and algebra (pedagogical remarks only); no mathematics by Gauss on this page

deep.surprise_reason: The page is printed preface text by Leiste. The only manuscript content is marginal number fragments that belong to the computation on the facing page (Gauss's constant 1/agm(1, √2) ≈ 0.834626841674), which is already well known to be Gauss's.

checkable.asserts: Gauss's constant 1/agm(1, sqrt(2)) = 0.8346268416740731..., the value computed on the facing page whose digit fragments appear in the left margin. Uses agm(1, sqrt2) = pi/(2*K(1/2)) * sqrt(2) with K(m) taking parameter m = k^2 = 1/2.
The lemniscate constant ratio varpi/pi equals the same 0.83462684167407...

transcription_corrections: The transcription omits the marginal handwritten digit fragments at the left edge (e.g. 7726, 5284, 640, 924, 589, 8513, 2862, 1375, 399, 297, 696, 583, 1/4 + 5/16, 90, 1033614740034, 1345616..., 17788013, 6681530, 182457, 7234608, 1028081791, 316399). These belong to the facing page's computations, not to this page.
The faint 'IV' at top right and the mirrored lines under the heading are bleed-through from the following page (p. IV), not part of this page.
The printed text transcription is otherwise accurate; the signature mark at the foot reads '* 2' and the catchword is 'meiner'.
